headline: Treasury's Bessent Backs Crypto Regulatory Clarity to Anchor Dollar
summary: The US Treasury Secretary stated at Ripple's conference that proactive SEC and CFTC action could bridge legislative gaps, curb debanking, and leverage digital assets to support the dollar.
why: Regulatory integration of digital assets by the US Treasury shapes institutional adoption, banking compliance, and global stablecoin standards.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency
impacts.why: Supportive regulatory signals from the US Treasury ease concerns around institutional digital asset access.
